subject: CentraBank - Private/VPC deployment discovery recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@centrabank.com>, Daniel Koh <daniel.koh@centrabank.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T18:12:00Z
Subject: CentraBank - Private/VPC deployment discovery recap & next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today. Helpful to hear more about CentraBank's platform constraints and goals — below is a quick recap of the pain points, desired outcomes, and proposed next steps so we can align teams.

Summary of pain points discussed
- Data residency & regulatory drivers: production PII and transaction records must remain in-country; regulators may require annual audit evidence.
- Air-gap readiness for certain environments (offline maintenance windows + restricted egress) — security team needs to validate update processes.
- Network topology constraints: limited inbound connections, preference for private peering (Direct Connect / ExpressRoute) or site-to-site VPN; strict proxy and firewall rules.
- KMS/HSM requirement for key custody and audit trails.

Goals we heard
- Run Redwood Private behind CentraBank's VPC with customer-managed keys, SAML SSO, and no egress of raw logs outside the bank.
- Meet latency SLOs for real-time workflows (95th < 120 ms for token-level inference on targeted endpoints).
- Maintain an update/patching model that satisfies security (ability to apply model updates on an approved maintenance cadence without breaking air-gapped sites).

What Redwood will provide / assumptions
- Private control plane with support for VPC peering and options for on-prem air-gapped appliance.
- KMS integrations (bring-your-own KMS) + audit logging; we can surface required fields for compliance review.
- Network template and example design (attached) to start with; we’ll validate compatibility with your firewall/proxy rules.

Attachments attached
- redwood-private-vpc-overview.pdf (overview + high level architecture)
- network-requirements-template.xlsx (fill this out with your network team)
- initial-ma-p.docx (draft mutual action plan we can iterate on)

Proposed next steps (action items)
1) Security deep-dive: schedule a 60-min call with CentraBank security + infra + Redwood security/infra. Suggested week of Sep 6 — Camila, Neha: what times look good? (Camila will own this).
2) CentraBank to return filled network-requirements-template.xlsx (Dan / infra).
3) Redwood to provide a short data flow diagram and SAML metadata for SSO integration ahead of the deep-dive.
4) We’ll surface a preliminary SOW and pricing delta for a dedicated on-prem or VPC-backed deployment after the deep-dive.

If I missed anything, flag and I’ll update. Thanks again — we’re excited to help you meet the regulatory constraints while keeping latency predictable.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. This matches what we discussed. A few clarifying notes / asks from our side: 

- Can you include a high-level data flow diagram that shows which telemetry/logs (if any) are sent outside the VPC? Our audit team will want to confirm no PII leaves the bank boundary.
- Our security lead (Aisha Malik) will join the deep-dive. She also requested a checklist of the evidence Redwood can provide (SOC2 artifact types, KMS audit exports, key rotation cadence).
- For air-gapped sites: do you have an outlined process for applying model updates offline (package + checksum + scheduled maintenance)? We need that in writing for our change governance.

We can return the filled network template by Sep 10. For scheduling, Sep 7 or Sep 9 afternoon (ET) works for us.

Thanks — Samantha

Hi Samantha — appreciate the notes. Adding answers inline and attaching a slightly expanded network template.

- Data flow: by default Redwood Private stores model weights and runtime on customer-managed infra. Telemetry can be configured: (a) full retention in-customer VPC only, (b) aggregated anonymized metrics sent to Redwood control plane for billing/health (opt-in). We will provide the diagram and a table of telemetry fields before the deep-dive.

- SOC2 & evidence: we can share SOC2 report summaries and the list of artifacts we typically provide (security policies, penetration test summaries, audit logs schema). We will not share the full SOC report until an NDA is in place; however a redacted summary and artifact list is usually acceptable to security reviews.

- Air-gap updates: our offline update process is: package build -> checksum signing -> offboarded media or approved transfer -> on-prem install by CentraBank infra with verification step. We’ll provide the documented process and a sample runbook.

Action items assigned
- Camila: schedule deep-dive (proposed Sep 7 14:00 ET / Sep 9 15:00 ET).
- Daniel: confirm network template completion by Sep 10.
- Neha: prepare SAML metadata and a short SSO integration checklist.
